verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email and calendar service, so sharing availability or inserting bookable times into an email is a fair question for it. The pack only contains a bare 'Calendar events and invitations' help-article title and a community note about calendar sync to Google. Neither documents availability sharing, scheduling links, or bookable slots inserted into email.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
